rubriker.title: Grandmasters Reaches 92 Amc Theaters Expands After Sold Out New York Premiere
Review: The Modern Benko Gambit - A Full Repertoire Against 1.d4 by GM Sipke Ernst
rubriker._rss_content: In his latest ChessBase course, Grandmaster Sipke Ernst thoroughly dispels the Benko Gambit's poor reputation. His modern approach, featuring an early 5...e6!, revolutionises the gambit, breathes new life into it and elegantly sidesteps White's traditional attempts at refutation. A new chapter in the history of the Benko Gambit has been written – and Christian Höthe takes a close look!

rubriker.title: Dortmund Sparkassen Trophy 2027
rubriker._rss_content: In 2027, the 54th International Dortmund Chess Days will mark a special chapter in their history spanning more than 50 years: from 8 to 15 August 2027, the Sparkassen Chess Trophy will be held for the first time in the “Salzlager” at the Hansa Coking Plant. As part of the 2027 International Garden Exhibition (IGA 2027), Germany’s longest-running chess festival will thus combine top-level international sport, grassroots chess and an extraordinary venue. The new venue allows for expansion to up to 450 participants.
